speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing unusual behaviors and beliefs regarding telepathic communication with animals; can you describe exactly what you hear or feel, and for how long this has been happening?

To help me assess this, please describe any physical symptoms like headaches, vision changes, or seizures you may have noticed.

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (with secondary somatic delusion).
